name: Settings list
summary: A group of settings rows — label left, control right — composing existing DS controls.
lead: TWO custom elements — <aha-settings-list> (a spacing-only group) and <aha-settings-item> (a labelled row with a `control` slot) — the reusable form of the settings pattern. It ships NO new control; it composes Switch / Checkbox / Select via the slot. Spacing-only hierarchy: no divider lines, no card/box around plain settings. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same elements, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes them via thin attribute wrappers; Vue binds the custom elements natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

whenToUse.when: a group of related on/off or choice settings in a panel, page or drawer
values are submitted together with validation and a submit step
one setting that applies on its own

opinion.note: Name each setting as a noun phrase (no leading verb — the control says on/off). Use a toggle for immediate effect, a checkbox for consent/saved-together — never mix in one group. Hierarchy is spacing, never lines or boxes; keep help text to at most one line per group. See the settings pattern for grouping, sub-settings and the danger zone.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — this is the reusable component form of the settings pattern (parts/settings.guide.md): label/control rows, spacing-only grouping, no dividers or boxes. It composes existing DS controls via a slot. A deliberate, documented AhaSlides surface.
